ℹ️ About this Map
This map shows K-Means (k=4) cluster assignments for 3,976 hexagonal grid cells (H3 resolution 7, ~5 km² per cell). Each dot represents one grid cell, coloured by its assigned airspace risk zone. Click any dot for detailed feature values.

This is the point-based cluster view from Notebook 04. For the full hexagonal risk zone map with clear airspace overlay, see risk_zone_map.html.
